adblockerDesc: $t(branding:dumaosName_short) can block adverts across every device on your network.
adblockerTip: $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.adblocker) will prevent your from seeing most web adverts, but will not block them if they are essential for the service to function properly.
changeNetworkSpeedsConfirmDesc:
To ensure accurate results, $t(branding:dumaosName) needs to revert to your original speed settings before testing again.

Resetting your speeds can take up to three minutes.

Do you still want to reset your speeds and test again?
dialDescription: Speed Test in progress, see the outcome of the test on the next page
pingTestFailedMessage: Press $t(setup:stepsContinue) to use default settings, which will prevent other usage types from interrupting your priority activities when they are detected.
pingTestFailedMessage2: To rerun this test, use $t(setup:stepsTryAgain) or run $t(branding:pingOptimiser) later from the Congestion Control option in the $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) section.
pingTestFailedMessage2_aria: To rerun this test, use $t(setup:stepsTryAgain) or run $t(branding:pingOptimiser) later from the Congestion Control option in the $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) section.
pingTestFailedTip: <bold>Good, it looks like your ping is already stable when the connection is busy.</bold>
pingTestIntroMessage: This is done by repeatedly measuring your delay (known as ping) whilst simulating busy household use.
pingTestIntroMessageTip: These tests will take up to three minutes.
pingTestIntroTip: $t(branding:dumaosName_short) can improve your gaming & video conferencing experience by applying the best network priority settings for your connection.
pingTestResultMessage: Press $t(setup:stepsOptimise) to reduce your ping by <bold>{{diff}}ms</bold> during busy times. This will help reduce lag in games or delays in video calls.
pingTestResultTip: Optimising your ping slightly reduces your useable internet speeds for others. This only happens while your priority activities are in progress.
prioritiseGamingTip: By prioritising Gaming you can reduce frustrating lag by putting your gaming traffic first and only connecting to nearby servers.
prioritiseWorkTip: By prioritising $t(misc:CategoryWorkAtHome) apps, you can prevent interruptions to your online meetings caused by other internet usage in the household.
searchCurrent_no_place: Press $t(setup:setLocation) to enter your nearest city or town (e.g. {{example_city}}).
searchForHomeTip: To aim for lower in-game ping times, $t(branding:dumaosName_short) provides a $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.geofilter) feature. It uses your location to force supported games to connect to servers near you. Add your gaming device in the $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.geofilter) screen after setup to start filtering for the best servers.
setupCompleteMessage: All done! $t(branding:dumaosName_short) will be set up with the following settings:
setupFailedError: Something went wrong, and DumaOS has failed to complete setup. Please try again in a few minutes.
speedTestConfirm: $t(branding:dumaosName_short) will use these speed settings to prioritise your connection. You can adjust them any time after setup by visiting Settings in the $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) section.
speedTestFinishedTip: If these speed settings don't look right, press $t(setup:stepsTestAgain)
speedTestIntroBrief: This test will take a short amount of time.
speedTestIntroDesc: To effectively prioritise your important internet use, $t(branding:dumaosName_short) needs your maximum connection speeds for its settings.
speedTestResultTip: Do these bandwidth speeds look correct?
speedTestRunningTip: To get the most accurate setting, perform this test whilst there is minimal use of the internet.
speedTest_ConfirmPlanSpeeds_current: Your detected internet plan speeds are:
speedTest_ConfirmPlanSpeeds_desc_alt: $t(branding:dumaosName) will use these speed settings to prioritise your connection. You can adjust them any time after setup by visiting Settings in the $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) section.
speedTest_ConfirmPlanSpeeds_tip: If your connection often performs above or below these speeds, use the $t(setup:speedTest_ConfirmPlanSpeeds_no) option. You can adjust these settings anytime after setup, in the $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.qos) menu.
thisCouldTakeThreeMinutes: This could take up to three minutes
welcomeMessageLine1: You're moments away from unlocking a set of features built to reduce lag and optimise your home network.
